{{Short description|German mathematician (born 1912)}}
{{about|the 20th-century mathematician|the 17th-century naturalist|Eberhard Melchior (naturalist)}}

'''Eberhard Melchior''' (born 12 November 1912 – July 11, 1956)<ref>Sterberegister Nr. 1065/1956 des Standesamts Dresden I</ref> was a German mathematician who provided the first proof of [[Sylvester&ndash;Gallai theorem|Sylvester's line problem]] in 1940.<ref name=melchior>
  E. Melchior (1940), ''Über Vielseite der Projektive Ebene.'' Deutsche Math. volume 5, pages 461&ndash;475
</ref> He also discovered the [[Melchior's inequality|related inequality]] now named after him.

Melchior was born in [[Dresden]] on 12 November 1912. He studied at the [[University of Göttingen]] and at the [[Dresden Technical University]] (TH Dresden). He obtained his Ph.D. at [[Berlin University]] on 2 June 1937 with a thesis on a problem on the theory of configurations<ref>Eberhard Melchior (1937), ''Untersuchungen über ein Problem aus der Theorie der Konfigurationen''. Ph.D. thesis, Berlin University.</ref> advised by [[Ludwig Bieberbach]].<ref name=mathgen>
[http://genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=19728 Eberhard Melchior]'s entry in the Mathematics Genealogy Project at University of North Dakota.  Accessed on 2009-12-30.</ref>
